thesis: The episode introduces the story of Jamie Dimon, detailing his rise to building Citigroup with mentor Sandy Weill, his subsequent firing in 1998, and his eventual leadership of J.P. Morgan Chase. The hosts note that the podcast is non-investment advice and serves for informational and entertainment purposes only.
